name: io.github.Axius-SDC/sdcmodeler
description: The modeler's client for SDCStudio: search the catalog, estimate, assemble and publish SDC4 models.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP stdio server rather than the CLI.

environmentVariables.name: SDCSTUDIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: An SDCStudio API key (Settings, API Keys) with the scopes and spending limit the agent should have. Optional: the catalog and estimates work without one.
